title: LE SSERAFIM’s Huh Yunjin Channels 2010 Taylor Swift With New Hairstyle: ‘Fearless Family Tree’
summary: The K-pop star is a longtime Swiftie.
contentText:
LE SSERAFIM ‘s Huh Yunjin is now fearlessly rocking a throwback hairstyle inspired by one of her biggest idols: Taylor Swift .

Related

LE SSERAFIM’s Sophomore Album ‘PUREFLOW’ pt. 1 Is on Its Way: Here’s When It Arrives

Taylor Swift’s Style Evolution, From 2006 to Now

7 Things We Learned From Taylor Swift’s ‘Greatest Living American Songwriters’ Interview

On Monday (April 27), the K-pop performer shared a carousel of Instagram photos of herself with her new look, slicking her recently dyed blonde hair into a ponytail with fresh bangs covering her forehead. It looks identical to the hairstyle Swift sported at the 2010 American Music Awards — photos from which Huh Yunjin interspersed in her post — to perform “Back to December” from her then-new third album Speak Now .

“uhhhh yeah lowkey its a fearless family tree,” the girl-group member captioned the snaps.

Sixteen years ago, Swift’s fringe and straightened tresses were considered edgy among fans. At the time, the 14-time Grammy winner hadn’t previously done much experimenting with her famous blonde curls, but now, bangs are a key part of her look, with Swift getting hers cut for real for the first time in late 2011 for a Vogue photo shoot.

If anyone would know the history of the Eras headliner’s hair, it would be Huh Yunjin. The South Korean-American singer is a major Swiftie who often cites the pop superstar as an inspiration for her own songwriting.

“More than the story itself, it’s how she tells it that really struck me at a young age,” she told W Magazine of Swift’s songwriting in 2023.

LE SSERAFIM is currently gearing up to drop new album PUREFLOW pt. 1 on May 22. The project will arrive after the group’s October single “Spaghetti” featuring BTS’ j-hope and new song “Celebration,” which dropped April 24.
